items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Well we know of course that Ronnie had started a club, and I went to the early club a couple of times

ctx.x: Well we know of course that Ronnie had started a club, and I went to the early club a couple of times in what they call Ronnie Scott’s old place, which was a sort of small basement which had been formerly a taxicab driver’s place in Soho. What they call a cabman’s shelter. It was where cabbies could go and have an off-duty cup of tea. And Ronnie got hold of it and he started the club. And I remember seeing Lucky Thompson there, a small room about half the size of this space we’re in, at about two and six pence,…
Who in your estimation is the greatest, or most influential British jazz product?
